messages:
erin: Opening a small PR to refresh the 'hello-ship' quickstart: switch auth examples to .env, add a compact multi-stage Dockerfile, include a GH Actions secret line, and a short "do not commit" callout. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012

devon: Nice. Can you paste the Dockerfile snippet here so I can skim?

erin: Pasting minimal Dockerfile (keeps app code unchanged):
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /build
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt -t /build/.deps
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /build/.deps /app/.deps
COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app
ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/.deps:/app
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```

samir: Looks good. Two asks: 1) show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` for locals and a 2-line .env example so folks don't paste tokens; 2) add a one-liner for GH Actions secrets: `echo \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | gh secret set REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

erin: Added both to the PR and a 3-line workflow snippet referencing the quickstart. Also replaced any example that printed tokens with placeholders.

ci-bot: Running checks... link-check found one stale link in docs/quickstarts/hello-ship.md -> ./auth-old.md; suggested replacement ../auth/setup.md. Secret-scan: no secrets found.

erin: Patched link in PR per ci-bot.

samir: Quick SDK check: make sure examples use `client.generate()` (current stable). We had a docs regression last month where an old helper reappeared.

erin: Confirmed the snippet uses `client.generate()` and updated the example to the typed kwargs pattern we recommend. Ran a local mock test.

devon: Tiny wording nit in the rate limits paragraph: add a short callout "For sustained >10 req/s consider Dedicated or batching" with link to /docs/dedicated/overview.

erin: Added that line. Also included a macOS Docker networking tip (if localhost:3000 unreachable try `--network=host`).

docsbot: Suggested tiny editorial tweak: replace "do not commit" with "do NOT commit" for visibility.

erin: Done. Will merge after CI green and cherry-pick to the next release branch. Ping here for follow-ups. :shipit:
